title: Exclude fixed-paid P104 chart-1089 splits (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7334, test a rank-nine productive split into ranks three and six at the retimed chart-1089 entrance. The paid itinerary stays fixed. All 12 pre-event cuts from 44588 through 44599 are tested for pivot 1081, with the entire public cochart bank and all 615 eligible boundary cohort roles. The exact public bank is [85,319,1081], with no owned rows. The rational exterior prefix has full rank three at every cut. An independent exact nonzero modular minor certifies each rank with unit denominators. Zero cuts remain unresolved. No suffix test or build was needed.

The complete pre-support change would be T3+17, T6+17, T9−17, with P unchanged. Gross one-edit upper 0.3528183420760684 raw at the exact crossing. One added paid rank-one position defeats the complete invoice margin. This chart and partition are distinct from #7339's chart-207 1+8 and #7332's chart-240 family.
